column1: # FAMILY TESTIMONY — WHAT THE FAMILY HAS TOLD THIS ARCHIVE, ATTRIBUTED AND DATED.
# A separate file because it is a separate grade of evidence. Nothing here is a document and

# "told, remembered, or written on somebody's family chart — not sourced."
# It is not ranked below a document. It answers things no document in existence could.

column4: what it settles, and what it does not

*** THIS CLOSES THE LARGEST HOLE IN THE ARCHIVE AND IT WAS NEVER GOING TO BE CLOSED BY A REGISTER. *** The question was put in writing on 27 September as the first of thirty, precisely because the documents could not reach it: the archive knew the marriage, the divorce action and the death, and had no idea whether the man had any part in the child's life. IT NOW HAS AN ANSWER IN FOUR WORDS. KURT ISRAEL LUWINSKI IS NOT DERRICK'S BIOLOGICAL FATHER — the DNA excludes him twice over and nothing here touches that — AND HE IS THE MAN WHO BROUGHT HIM UP. Both are true, and the archive now says both.

column1: # ---------------- WHY THE DOCUMENTS MADE IT LOOK UNLIKELY, AND WHY THEY DO NOT ACTUALLY CONTRADICT IT ----------------

column2: Ivone married Kurt on 19 JUNE 1948, seventeen days after her previous husband divorced her. KURT SUED HER THE SAME YEAR — WLD 1950/1948 — AND THE CHILD WAS BORN AFTER HE HAD FILED. Read on its own, that is a man leaving before his wife has given birth, which is how this archive wrote it up: "within months of the wedding and before the child was born".

column1: *** AND THE COURT FILE ITSELF SHOULD HAVE WARNED AGAINST THAT READING ***
column2: THE ACTION WAS FOR RESTITUTION OF CONJUGAL RIGHTS, and it was not granted until 1951. In South African practice that was the required first step of a divorce — you sued for your spouse's return, and the order converted to divorce only if she did not comply. SO THE MARRIAGE RAN ON PAPER FOR ABOUT THREE YEARS, from June 1948 to 1951, AND THE CHILD WAS BORN INSIDE IT. A filing date is not a departure date, and this archive had been treating it as one.

column1: the lesson, and it is the same one four times over this fortnight
column2: A DOCUMENT RECORDS AN ACT, NOT A LIFE. The file records the day a man instructed an attorney. It does not record what he did for the next twenty years, and it cannot. THE ARCHIVE WAS RIGHT TO REFUSE TO SAY HE RAISED HIM AND RIGHT TO REFUSE TO SAY HE DID NOT; what it got wrong was writing the filing date in a way that leaned.

column1: # ---------------- WHAT IS STILL OPEN, BECAUSE FOUR WORDS DO NOT ANSWER EVERYTHING ----------------
still unknown, and only Derrick can say
column2: FOR HOW LONG, AND WHERE. Whether Kurt was in the household before the 1951 decree, after it, or throughout. Whether Derrick lived with him, or with Ivone, or moved between them — she married Morris Salkow in February 1953 and that marriage lasted months. Kurt remarried too: PAULINE, who died in 1985. WHETHER DERRICK GREW UP IN KURT'S HOUSE OR IN HIS MOTHER'S IS NOT KNOWN HERE.

Kurt died at Johannesburg on 15 DECEMBER 1968. Questions 1 to 6 of the sheet put to Derrick stand and are now sharper rather than answered: what he remembers, what was said at home, and whether anything of Kurt's survives.

column1: *** AND IT CHANGES WHAT THE BERLIN QUESTIONS ARE WORTH ***
column2: If Kurt raised him, then AUGUSTE "LIZZY" LUWINSKI — Kurt's mother, who survived the war and died at Kraichtal on 22 JUNE 1975 — was the grandmother of the house Derrick was raised in, not a stranger on a chart. And SIEGFRIED LEIBHOLZ, hidden near Sommerfeld as a boy from January 1943 to April 1945 and alive until 1 FEBRUARY 2005, was his uncle in fact and not only on paper. QUESTIONS 7 TO 10 WERE THE SECOND SECTION OF THE SHEET. THEY ARE NOW THE MOST VALUABLE THING ON IT.

column1: how this is handled in the build
column2: graded FAMILY on the shared ladder wherever it appears, attributed to the person who said it and dated. NOT MERGED INTO THE DOCUMENTARY RECORD, and not printed in the confident voice the archive uses for a register. If it is ever contradicted by a document, both stay and the conflict is published.
